data.title: All 12 League Two predictions – October, 20th October 2026
data.content:
Grimsby’s weekend loss to Northampton (0-2) was their fourth defeat in a row in League Two, and to compound their misery, Edon Pruti picked up a serious injury in the second half, not long after Doug Tharme had to be withdrawn, too. Not much is going right for the Mariners at present and they could slip up again at Rochdale.

Score prediction: Rochdale 2-1 Grimsby Town

Back Rochdale to Win against Grimsby Town at 21/10 with LiveScore Bet [...] ### Rochdale vs Grimsby Town (Tuesday, 7:45 pm)

Rochdale were three goals down by the hour mark against Crewe on Saturday, but rallied late and cut the deficit to 3-2 by the end. Buoyed by that showing, the Dale will be targeting a win when they host struggling Grimsby on Tuesday. Rochdale came out on top in three of their last four matches at Crown Oil Arena and they can harness home advantage again here. [...] ### Northampton Town vs Tranmere Rovers (Tuesday, 7:45 pm)

Goals from Matty Warhurst and Jon Guthrie earned Northampton an excellent 2-0 win at Grimsby on Saturday, a victory that allowed the Cobblers to climb out of the relegation places. Improving Town have now lost only twice in their last seven matches in League Two and they’ve been priced as favourites to beat Tranmere at Sixfields on Tuesday.
